title: Normalized identity, composition and section pullback comparisons
statement:
Normalized identity, composition and section pullback comparisons. In the notation of [def-sfb-ringed-projection-coherence-data], the assertion is theorem ringedProjectionPullbackComparisons : Nonempty (PullbackComparisons.{u, w}). The structure is:

structure PullbackComparisons where
  identity : ∀ {X : RingedTensorCorner.{u, w}} (h : RingedTensorEdge X X) (s : Identity h),
    ∃ l : h.left ≅ 𝟭 X.mateDerived, s.Normalized l
  composition : ∀ {X Y Z : RingedTensorCorner.{u, w}}
    (f : RingedTensorEdge Y X) (g : RingedTensorEdge Z Y) (h : RingedTensorEdge Z X)
    (s : Composition f g h), ∃ l : h.left ≅ g.left ⋙ f.left, s.Normalized l
  sectionComparison : ∀ {X W : RingedTensorCorner.{u, w}}
    (i : RingedTensorEdge W X) (p : RingedTensorEdge X W) (s : Section i p),
    ∃ l : p.left ⋙ i.left ≅ 𝟭 X.mateDerived, s.Normalized l

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YU, 07A4, 0D6D and 0FPI; flat K-flat computation and canonical tensor comparisons

proof.text: The homotopy quotient on flat K-flat complexes is full and essentially surjective. Descend a natural isomorphism through this quotient using preimages and naturality, then use Localization.liftNatIso for the flat K-flat localization supplied by tensor descent. Each edge preserves flat K-flat complexes and its comparison map is a natural isomorphism on this class. Compose and invert these natural isomorphisms around the supplied ordinary module comparison, lifted termwise and then by Q. Descend the result to the derived category. Its component equation gives identity and section normalization directly, and composition normalization by cancelling the two successive comparison isomorphisms. No projection map or tensor compatibility is used.
